# Archive statistics browser dependencies

Pinned, locally served distributions (no runtime CDN required):

- Apache ECharts 5.6.0: https://www.npmjs.com/package/echarts/v/5.6.0 — Apache-2.0, see ECHARTS-LICENSE.txt. Original distribution retains notices.
- h3-js 4.1.0: https://www.npmjs.com/package/h3-js/v/4.1.0 — Apache-2.0, see H3-LICENSE.txt.
- fzstd 0.1.1: https://www.npmjs.com/package/fzstd/v/0.1.1 — MIT, see FZSTD-LICENSE.txt.

`../../data/countries-110m.json` derives from Natural Earth's 1:110m admin_0 countries, downloaded 2026-09-17 from https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson . Geometry is unchanged; properties reduced to ADMIN (renamed name). Natural Earth data is public domain: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ . Boundaries are approximate and do not imply a position on disputed territories.
